description: A STRESS SUITE WAS RUN AGAINST THE PROCEEDINGS SUBSYSTEM (PR #373) AND IS RECORDED AT proposals/2026-09-05-proceedings-subsystem/20_STRESS_TESTS.md, with the executable harness at stress/stress_proceedings.py. THE ASK (Jordan, 2026-09-07): 'run a suite of logical stress tests for how the proceedings within the subsystem and the subsystem itself will run', and 'log all instances where you have had to create/invent something for the subsystem to work (eg a character, docket own)', plus all mechanical decisions, gaps, conflicts and failures. METHOD: 38 tests executed against proposals/2026-09-01-season-loop-tests/tracer/shape.py, the tracer this directory already cites by line number; a fixture world built from nothing so that every element of it is a logged invention; a sixteen-step worked trial; and a per-game matrix derived from the other tests' verdicts. Verdicts: 4 RAN, 16 BLOCKED, 18 FAILED. REGISTERS: 23 inventions (8 harness fixtures, 15 mechanisms the design owes), 8 mechanical decisions each with its alternative and a falsifier, 35 findings each carrying an evidence grade and an already-registered line. 20 OF THE 35 RESTATE A ROW THE DESIGN ALREADY CARRIES and say so; 15 are new. WHAT PASSES, credited: a seatless speak folds and emits; the appeal depth cap returns a typed ContestError; a seeded proceeding replays identically (21 Events, 18 claims, twice); and permuting who attends does not move the outcome -- 05_PROCEDURE.md's own permutation criterion, run for the first time. THE FIVE NEW RESULTS THAT SURVIVED ADVERSARIAL ATTACK: (F-14) `disposes:` names a write and has no writer -- determine grades a Tenure and cannot open one, and 11_NERS.md's diagonal PASS rests on that write verbatim. (F-38) the count table at 00_DERIVATION.md B.1, which README calls 'the whole argument', is stale in three of five rows: the fields cell names Proposition.rung and describes B.2 as ADMITTING what B.2 retracts, the verbs cell says '4 new' where two other files say ZERO, and the carriers cell lists `Seat`, which is not a carrier. (F-37) five P-rows are registered by the files that raise them and appear in the gap register nowhere -- P-22, P-23, P-24, P-28, P-29 -- which is the exact condition PART C of that register quotes as invisible to both counts. (F-28) the ladder rung is specified as a fold over emitted matter.* Events and no emission can name a rung, so the zero-new-fields result rests on a fold with no operand. (F-33) under the fan-out arm in force there is no such thing as being absent: the subject who never travelled ends the season holding the same claims as the bench member who sat through it, so 07_THE_GAME.md PART E's 'a player can be condemned and not know it' is a claim about a sweep arm. And one CORRECTION rather than a discovery (F-32): the directory's headline diagnosis is that no deposit names the actor -- one does; the defect is that deposit's CONTENT, so 19_PLAN.md step 2 is aimed one step to the left of the hole. THE SHAPE: no arrangement row is blocked on a parameter of its own; all twelve are stopped by needs shared across the catalogue. That is the closure claim holding in the only direction currently testable, and it is also why twelve rows have not yet bought anything. Of sixteen steps in one worked trial, the five that are supplied are all things the tree owned before this design existed. ADVERSARIAL: two structurally independent read-only critics (Read/Grep/Glob, no write tools) attacked the suite's output on disjoint lanes without seeing its reasoning. They killed TWO findings outright (F-08 claimed convene's `scale:` key was gone -- it is at verb_table.yaml:138, and the finding contradicted itself in its own output string; F-21 claimed disposal_reach needs a sixth witness channel -- _ch_post_remit and _ch_chronicle already carry `body` and `<rung kind>`), overturned a THIRD as stale (F-16 treated the quorum as open; P-15 is closed by ED-SC-0034 and the gap-register row is the stale surface), VOIDED an execution (the docket test ran one season against a date due at tick 1 and measured its own off-by-one), and corrected four counts including the worst defect in the suite -- the per-game matrix's `runnable = []` was an identity that could not have come out otherwise. All applied and recorded in place at PART F. STATUS: open, and NOT needs_jordan -- every item is an engineering answer or a documentation correction. What is genuinely a call remains 19_PLAN.md PART H's, which is already ruled. NOTHING RATIFIES: the directory stays PROPOSED and HELD BACK IN FULL, and this work edits no design file. [CLOSED 2026-09-26: all five findings that survived adversarial attack are dispositioned, each at a different site -- not uniformly by one PHASE, corrected from an earlier draft of this note -- verified by hand this pass -- (F-37) closed by 21_RECONCILIATION.md PHASE 0 (0a/0b) -- 10_LOOPS_AND_GAPS.md section B.5 now carries P-22/P-23/P-24/P-28/P-29; (F-38) closed by 21_RECONCILIATION.md PHASE 0 -- 00_DERIVATION.md's three stale count-table cells read CORRECTED 2026-09-07; (F-33) closed by executed step 1 (ED-IN-0205), 21_RECONCILIATION.md PART A -- engine/season/tests/test_season_shape.py test_r7_two_persons_hold_different_things_and_at_total_they_cannot makes absence representable at the shipped fan-out arm; (F-14) downgraded at 21_RECONCILIATION.md PART B.3 from 'needs a design answer' to 'the row contradicts the plan' -- the design-file fold (04_VERBS.md writes: Tenure.since, Tenure.degree) is done, the writer itself is unbuilt and tracked at 19_PLAN.md step 15 inside the held-back directory, not resolved by this pass; (F-28) ruled at 21_RECONCILIATION.md PART C, C-2 -- NEITHER a field nor an Event kind, a fold over the run's own acts. TWO residuals C-2 asked for, both missed in an earlier draft of this closure and corrected in this same pass: the formula sentence at 00_DERIVATION.md's rung definition, AND the witnessed-concession sentence (section on the descent cost) which needed the kind-granularity qualifier -- plus two instances of stale 'emissions' prose in the same blockquote that contradicted the corrected formula three lines away. All four now read consistently. 20_STRESS_TESTS.md's own front matter already says CLOSED RECORD, NOT A WORK QUEUE. registers/handoffs/HANDOFF_SC.md's row citing this entry was DELETED (not corrected) in the same commit, its content now covered by this entry. NOTHING RATIFIES: proposals/2026-09-05-proceedings-subsystem/ stays PROPOSED, HELD BACK IN FULL; this closure is a citation correction, not a ruling. VERIFIED BY AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY CRITIC (opus) which opened every citation above and found this note's first draft imprecise in exactly the ways now corrected.]

JORDAN RULED, 2026-09-26: two of his 2026-09-04 rulings, relayed only inside the scope-banned proposals/2026-09-04-social-contest-branches/ corpus and never seen by proposals/2026-09-05-proceedings-subsystem/ (built under an explicit ban on reading that directory), APPLY TO ALL TWELVE PROCEEDING ROWS in the successor design -- not to the single game (negotiation) each was first raised against. THE TWO RULINGS, VERBATIM, as relayed by the coordinator and recorded at 11_FOUR_GAMES_AUDIT_AND_PLAN.md:26-28 / 12_STRUCTURAL_INTERROGATION.md:13 / 01_SPINE.md:322-323: (1) MULTI-MATTER/CONDITIONAL ADJUDICATION -- 'there are many different lines of adjudication requiring verdict so you can win on one thing but partially lose three items and lose completely on five' and 'all of these games may concern more than one topic or the topic is a bundle of subtopics, and we need to be able to handle conditions and stuff.' (2) BINDING-IN-SCENE -- 'negotiated agreement bind in scene. in fact, everything that occurs within a scene should bind or else it's as if time doesn't exist within a season.' WHAT THIS SETTLES: 19_PLAN.md PART I item 1 ('the outer act's degree is not specified anywhere ... the seam returns one margin -- but a proceeding is six draws', 19_PLAN.md:980-984) is answered toward a per-matter outcome, not the single-margin default the plan shipped without ruling (1) in view; the seam's unit of resolution (05_PROCEDURE.md:36 seam.proceed(...) -> Margin; 08_SEAM.md:21-26) needs a per-issue vector before step 14's bar runs, per 09-04's own construction against the same §C.5 contract (11_FOUR_GAMES_AUDIT_AND_PLAN.md:243-266,285-294: a per-issue outcome vector plus a condition tuple for conditional concessions). P-14/D-8 (10_LOOPS_AND_GAPS.md:81; 19_PLAN.md:962-965; 21_RECONCILIATION.md:673-682) -- closed as 'NOT a decision request' / 'the honest answer is nothing' -- was closed WITHOUT ruling (2) in view. Ruling (2) does not by itself force same-season pronouncement (a scene's outcome must bind within the season; a later-season 'game result' framing may still satisfy that), so P-14/D-8's closure is not overturned outright, but MUST be re-examined against the verbatim text before a build session treats it as settled. NOT RATIFYING: this entry records two of Jordan's rulings and confirms their scope; it does not ratify proposals/2026-09-05-proceedings-subsystem/ (still PROPOSED, HELD BACK IN FULL per its own Status lines as of this entry) and makes no edit to that directory's content. Re-opening PART I item 1 and P-14/D-8 against this entry, and threading the per-matter outcome through the twelve-row design, is a build-session's work, not this commit's.
